facts.business: Procter & Gamble Health Limited is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceuticals and chemicals, operating in the consumer health, nutraceutical and vitamins segment.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Litigation with government authorities and contingencies, including pending tax litigation and NPPA demand notices for overcharging prices of pharmaceutical products.

key_risks: Pending litigation with tax authorities for several financial years at various stages and forums
NPPA orders and demand notices for overcharging prices of pharmaceutical products
Evolving global trade policies and commodity prices impacting inflation and cost of goods
Significant management judgment required for uncertain tax and legal matters
